```yaml
name: Scripts for Android Build

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest]

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up JDK 1.8
      if: runner.os == 'Linux'
      uses: actions/setup-java@v2
      with:
        java-version: '1.8'
        distribution: 'adopt'

    - name: Set up JDK 1.8 for macOS
      if: runner.os == 'macOS'
      run: |
        if [[ $(uname -m) == "arm64" ]]; then
          brew install openjdk@8
          echo "/usr/local/opt/openjdk@8/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH
        fi

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        sudo apt-get update
        sudo apt-get install -y maven git

    - name: Configure environment
      run: source tools/env.sh

    - name: Generate BUILDING.md
      run: |
        echo "# Building CodenameOne\n" > BUILDING.md
        echo "- Ensure you have JDK 1.8 installed.\n" >> BUILDING.md
        echo "- For Apple Silicon, use the Intel JDK 8.\n" >> BUILDING.md

    - name: Setup workspace
      run: ./scripts/setup-workspace.sh -q -DskipTests

    - name: Build Android Port
      run: ./scripts/build-android-port.sh -q -DskipTests

    - name: Run yamllint
      run: yamllint .github/workflows/scripts-android.yml .github/workflows/scripts-ios.yml
```

This GitHub Actions workflow file sets up a CI pipeline for building the CodenameOne project, specifically focusing on the Android port. It includes steps to set up the appropriate JDK version based on the operating system, configure the environment, generate a build guide, and run various build commands while skipping unnecessary tests and documentation generation. The workflow also includes a step to lint the YAML files using `yamllint`.
